business.en: They raised millions of dollars from investors, even though their business models were unrealistic.
business.zh: 它们从投资者那里筹集了数百万美元，尽管它们的商业模式根本不切实际。

business.en: He then awards the business the contract to build a bridge or a road.
business.zh: 然后他就会把建造桥梁或道路的合同判给这家企业。

business.en: I use Japanese for my business paperwork, for when I go to the shop.
business.zh: 我的公司公文要用日语，去商店买东西也用日语。

business.en: Interests can mean things like investments business ownings or things that they are connected to.
business.zh: 利益可以指投资、企业所有权或他们与之相关联的事物等。

business.en: Singapore is now a major center for finance, shipping, aviation, technology, international business.
business.zh: 新加坡现在是金融、航运、航空、科技和国际商业的重要中心。

bulb.en: It’s not like a tulip bulb from the 1700s, AI is actually a useful thing.
bulb.zh: 它不像1700年代的郁金香球茎，AI确实是一个有用的东西。

bulb.en: However, in 1637, the market collapsed. People realized that tulip bulbs had no value.
bulb.zh: 然而，到了1637年，市场崩溃了。人们意识到郁金香球茎根本没有价值。

bulb.en: Right now, the unit that scientists use to measure the energy imbalance of the planet – how much it's out of whack – is Watts, like in a light bulb, per square metre.
bulb.zh: 目前，科学家用来测量地球能量不平衡的单位——即它失衡的程度——是瓦特，就像灯泡那样，每平方米。

bulb.en: So while a Google search might use enough energy to power a light bulb for a few seconds, generating a single AI image or a long ChatGPT reply, early critics pointed out, might use ten, twenty, or even fifty times more.
bulb.zh: 因此，谷歌搜索可能只消耗足够让灯泡亮几秒钟的能量，而早期批评者指出，生成单张 AI 图片或一条长篇 ChatGPT 回复，可能会消耗十倍、二十倍甚至五十倍的能量。

bump.en: Liv's poem gave Kat goosebumps, meaning she was so emotionally affected that the hairs on her skin stood up, making tiny bumps.
bump.zh: 丽夫的诗让卡特起了鸡皮疙瘩，意思是她受到了很大的情感触动，以至于皮肤上的毛发都竖了起来，起了一小粒一小粒的疙瘩。

bump.en: You know, and so I, strangely enough, I feel like it's all of these people that I was lucky enough, or unlucky enough to bump into that gave me a little bit of that texture and shape.
bump.zh: 所以，奇怪的是，我觉得正是所有这些我有幸或不幸遇到的人，给了我那一点点质感和形状。

bump.en: Interesting. Let's see what happens when you have 30 other things every single week vying for your attention. now let's see how committed you are this is my favorite analogy for this which is the woman in the red dress but you know every many people have seen the matrix if you haven't seen the matrix you don't need to have seen it to understand the analogy so neo is going through the training program the protagonist morpheus is his his educator his his teacher and the education program only has one objective and so he's walking through the city people are going left and right he's bumping into people going through like crowded new york and then all of a sudden it's kind of a black and white, palish look.
bump.zh: 有趣。让我们看看当你每周有30件其他事情争夺你的注意力时会发生什么。现在让我们看看你有多坚定。这是我最喜欢的类比，就是红衣女郎。很多人看过《黑客帝国》，如果你没看过，不需要看过也能理解这个类比。Neo 正在通过训练程序，Morpheus 是他的导师，教育程序只有一个目标。所以他走在城市里，人们来来往往，他在拥挤的纽约穿梭，突然间，画面变得有点黑白、苍白。

bureau.en: In 2025, over 1000 people contacted the UK Citizens Advice Bureau every single day of the year for help with their debt.
bureau.zh: 在2025年，每天都有超过1000人联系英国公民咨询局寻求债务帮助。

bunch.en: Things are happening and you're reacting to them. and I read a bunch of books.
bunch.zh: 事情发生了，你就在做出反应。我读了很多书。

bunch.en: Martin conducted a whole bunch of – meaning a lot of – tests using different colours and patterns.
bunch.zh: Martin 进行了 a whole bunch of——意思是“许多”——使用不同颜色和图案的测试。

bunch.en: And we have a bunch of other “horror”-themed episodes, or ones about “weird history” too.
bunch.zh: 我们还有一堆其他以“恐怖”为主题的节目，或者关于“猎奇历史”的节目。

bunch.en: A bunch is a number of things, often a large number of things.
bunch.zh: A bunch是一堆东西，通常指数量很多的东西。

bunch.en: I actually had him on the show. I've talked to him a bunch.
bunch.zh: 我确实请他上过节目。我和他聊过很多次。

burn.en: The burning had happened inside the cave, repeatedly, over time, in the same spot.
burn.zh: 燃烧是发生在洞穴内部的，随着时间的推移，在同一个地点反复发生。

burn.en: And so to the same degree, people are like, I feel burnt out.
burn.zh: 所以同样地，人们说：我感到精疲力竭。

burn.en: And finally, if something is flammable,iteasily burns or catches fire.
burn.zh: 最后，如果某样东西是 flammable(易燃的)，就是说它很容易燃烧或着火。

burn.en: And people in northeast England and South Wales had been burning it in small quantities for generations.
burn.zh: 英格兰东北部和南威尔士的人们世世代代一直在小批量地燃烧它。

burn.en: The first was ritualistic; people burned aromatic resins, woods, and spices as offerings to their gods.
burn.zh: 第一个是宗教仪式性质的；人们燃烧芳香树脂、木材和香料作为对神的供奉。

bucket.en: Yay! OK. Let's recap the vocabulary we've learned, starting with bucket list – all the things you would like to do before you die.
bucket.zh: 太棒了！好的。让我们复习一下我们学过的词汇，从“bucket list”（愿望清单）开始——你在死前想做的一切事情。

bucket.en: Have you ever heard someone say, “kick the bucket” or “pass away,” and felt confused?
bucket.zh: 你有没有听过别人说“kick the bucket”或“pass away”，然后感到很困惑？

bucket.en: And with this very real monetary incentive, diving bell technology did increase dramatically, and divers were able to go down to depths of twenty or so metres and stay there for extended periods of time, supported either by tubes or sealed buckets of fresh air delivered from the surface.
bucket.zh: 随着这种非常现实的金钱激励，潜水钟技术有了显著的提高，潜水员能够下潜到二十米左右的深度并在那里停留很长时间，由从水面输送的管道或密封的新鲜空气桶提供支持。

bucket.en: I'm Phil. And I'm Beth. A list is a collection of items with a single item written on each line, and they're everywhere: shopping lists, to-do lists, even bucket lists – a list of all the things a person would like to do before they die.
bucket.zh: 我是Phil。我是Beth。清单是指每行写着单一项目的物品集合，它们无处不在：购物清单、待办事项清单，甚至是愿望清单——一个人在死前想做的事情的清单。

buzz.en: The buzzing sound bees are famous for is made by flapping their four wings incredibly fast, but how fast?
buzz.zh: 蜜蜂闻名遐迩的嗡嗡声是由它们以极快的速度拍打四翅产生的，但速度有多快呢？

buzz.en: Flies buzzing around. The clink of spurs.
buzz.zh: 苍蝇嗡嗡飞舞，马刺叮当作响。

budget.en: Another point of contention was the UK’s financial contributions to the EU budget.
budget.zh: 另一个争论点是英国对欧盟预算的财政贡献。

budget.en: Indeed, in 1970, he is estimated to have stolen 60% of the entire country’s annual budget.
budget.zh: 事实上，据估计，仅在1970年他就盗用了全国年度预算的60%。

budget.en: Alicia wants to tackle the things that stop people eating healthy food on a budget.
budget.zh: Alicia想要解决那些阻碍人们在预算有限的情况下吃上健康食品的问题。

budget.en: At the end of Richard's budget process, the math they come up with is fairly stark.
budget.zh: 在理查德的预算流程接近尾声时，他们算出来的数学账目可以说是相当严峻。

budget.en: The commission has three main roles. Propose new laws, enforce EU rules, and manage the EU’s budget.
budget.zh: 该委员会有三大主要职责：提出新法律、执行欧盟规则以及管理欧盟预算。

bud.en: Science's understanding of how taste works started only 25 years ago with the discovery of taste receptors, cells located in the taste buds on your tongue.
bud.zh: 科学界对味觉运作机制的认识，直到 25 年前发现味觉受体才真正开始——这是一种位于舌头味蕾中的细胞。

bud.en: This meal that you're having, just taste these ingredients what what is taste feel it on your on your on your taste buds and and like one of the tools they they teach you like with adhd sometimes you know when when it when it makes you go into anxiety or depression is to just notice things practice being present walk down the street and like look like really look and say out loud what you're seeing and at first it's very stupid that is a red door that is a green roof that is a pigeon sitting on the gutter that is a gutter, that is a gray car that is driven by.
bud.zh: 你正在吃的这顿饭，只是品尝这些成分，什么……什么是味道，在你的味蕾上感受它，然后……他们教你的工具之一，有时你知道，当ADHD让你陷入焦虑或抑郁时，就是去注意事物。练习活在当下。走在街上，像……真正地看，并大声说出你所看到的。起初这很愚蠢：那是一扇红色的门，那是一个绿色的屋顶，那是一只鸽子坐在排水沟上，那是一个排水沟，那是一辆灰色的车，由……驾驶。

bureaucracy.en: Oil paid for everything—the palaces, the welfare state, the military, the sprawling bureaucracy.
bureaucracy.zh: 石油支付了一切费用——宫殿、福利国家、军队、庞大的官僚机构。

bureaucracy.en: At the same time, the government placed enormous emphasis on stability and bureaucracy.
bureaucracy.zh: 与此同时，政府极度强调稳定和官僚体制。

bureaucracy.en: We’re talking about millions of people, a vast bureaucracy, a government.
bureaucracy.zh: 我们讨论的是数百万人口、一个庞大的官僚机构和一个政府。

bureaucracy.en: He presented himself not as an ideologue or fanatic, but as a functionary: a man who had followed orders inside a vast bureaucracy.
bureaucracy.zh: 他把自己塑造成的形象，不是一个信奉某种意识形态的狂热分子，而是一个“办事员”：一个在庞大官僚体系中执行命令的人。

bureaucracy.en: For its supporters, DOGE is a bold experiment in making government leaner and more accountable, a chance to finally tackle the bureaucracy that’s been slowing America down.
bureaucracy.zh: 对于支持者来说，DOGE 是一场让政府更精简、更负责的大胆实验，是一个终于可以着手解决拖慢美国后腿的官僚主义的机会。

button.en: No, I would press that button. I would erase my mother being shot.
button.zh: 不，我会按那个按钮。我会擦除我母亲被枪击的事。

button.en: I would love, really love to have a silver play button from YouTube.
button.zh: 我真的很想、真的很想拿到 YouTube 的银色播放按钮。

button.en: I just remember she hit the button and I just wasn't that upset.
button.zh: 我只记得她按下了那个按钮，而我居然没有那么生气。

button.en: But if I could, I would press that button because I, yeah.
button.zh: 但如果可以，我会按那个按钮，因为我，是的。

button.en: I feel like the hot button on joy for me is what I'm doing right now.
button.zh: 我觉得对我来说，快乐的触发点就是我正在做的事情。

bundle.en: Financial institutions also created complex financial products called mortgage backed securities, which basically bundled many risky loans together and then sold them.
bundle.zh: 金融机构还创造了被称为抵押贷款支持证券的复杂金融产品，这基本上是将许多高风险贷款捆绑在一起然后出售。

bundle.en: He'd tramp through mosquito infested jungles with bundles of maps and a theodolite, a type of instrument used for surveying territory and measuring angles.
bundle.zh: 他会背着一捆捆地图和经纬仪——一种用于勘测地形和测量角度的仪器，跋涉在蚊虫肆虐的丛林中。

bundle.en: First, it's thought it was through percussion, striking pieces of flint against iron pyrite to create sparks that could catch in a small bundle of tinder: small, dry pieces of wood or leaves.
bundle.zh: 首先，人们认为是通过打击乐般的方法，用燧石敲击黄铁矿产生火花，这些火花可以点燃一小捆火绒：细小、干燥的木头或树叶。

bundle.en: I was as green as you could be. Mike Garner's job-- the guy in Nevada-- was to buy up individual mortgages, mainly from brokers, bundle 200 or 300 of them together, and then sell them up the chain to Wall Street, to guys like Mike Francis.
bundle.zh: 我当时菜得不能再菜了。Mike Garner 的工作——身处内华达州的那个家伙——就是收购个人抵押贷款，主要从经纪人那里收购，把 200 或 300 个打包在一起，然后往上游卖给华尔街，卖给像 Mike Francis 这样的家伙。

buffalo.en: So, he has had what we might call a “portfolio career” so far: buffalo hunter, stagecoach driver, horse thief, and now deputy marshal.
buffalo.zh: 所以到目前为止，他的履历可以说相当“多元”：猎野牛的猎人、驿马车车夫、盗马贼，如今又成了副警长。

buffalo.en: In his twenties, he worked as a buffalo hunter on the Kansas plains, when the vast herds that had roamed the great plains for centuries were being systematically slaughtered for their hides.
buffalo.zh: 二十多岁时，他在堪萨斯平原上当过猎捕野牛的猎人，当时那些在大平原上漫游了几个世纪的庞大兽群，正被有计划地大批猎杀以获取兽皮。

burst.en: His trousers were torn to shreds, his arm was damaged, and his eardrum burst.
burst.zh: 他的裤子被炸成了碎片，手臂受伤，耳膜破裂。

burst.en: Housing bubbles burst, major financial institutions collapsed, and governments were forced to intervene.
burst.zh: 房地产泡沫破裂，主要金融机构倒闭，各国政府被迫干预。

burst.en: So, if AI is in a bubble, what could happen if it bursts?
burst.zh: 那么，如果AI正处于泡沫之中，如果它破裂了会发生什么？

burst.en: Even if a bubble bursts, it can leave behind useful innovation, useful technology.
burst.zh: 即使泡沫破裂，它也能留下有用的创新和有用的技术。

burst.en: At one dinner party in ancient Rome, hosted by the then-emperor, Caligula, the host burst out in raucous laughter.
burst.zh: 在古罗马的一场晚宴上，由当时的皇帝 Caligula 主办，主人突然爆发出一阵粗鲁刺耳的大笑。

bug.en: But there was nothing there. It wasn’t mice, it wasn’t some pest, or bed bugs.
bug.zh: 但周围什么也没有。不是老鼠，不是什么害虫，也不是臭虫。

bug.en: And this wasn’t a one-off. The teenage boy had got the bug, he had had a small taste of adventure.
bug.zh: 这并非偶然。这个少年已经迷上了这件事，他初尝了冒险的滋味。

bug.en: All this time, Ulbricht was managing the site himself, doing everything from fixing bugs to negotiating with hackers to providing customer service.
bug.zh: 在这段时间里，Ulbricht 一直在独自管理这个网站，从修复漏洞、与黑客谈判到提供客户服务，什么都做。

bug.en: Like it doesn't really bug me very much.
There are rumours he was poisoned, perhaps on Tiberius’ orders, or perhaps it was one of the many bugs that could have proved fatal for travelling soldiers back then.
bug.zh: 有传言说他是被毒死的，也许是奉了 Tiberius 的命令，或者也许只是当时对旅行中的士兵来说致命的众多病毒之一。

bull.en: The Minotaur. The Minotaur was a creature that was half man and half bull.
bull.zh: 米诺陶洛斯。米诺陶洛斯是一个半人半牛的生物。

bull.en: They are unaware of the emotional undercurrents swirling around them, and they often behave like bulls in china shops.
bull.zh: 他们对周围涌动的情绪暗流毫无察觉，行事常常就像闯进瓷器店的公牛。

butt.en: Now, you'd rather be out here barefoot, butt naked in the sun, I think.
butt.zh: 现在，我觉得你更愿意光着脚、光着屁股在阳光下待着。

butcher.en: And there's a religious aspect to it. And then the capitalist individualist is like, libertarian every man for himself you just each do what you want and it'll work out for the greater good that's adam smith you know the invisible hand of the market will feed you the baker should bake and the butcher should butcher and the candlestick maker should make candlesticks and it'll all work out each person does their best and they trade and so which is it which which which which theory is correct and i think there's always going to be a battle between the two and i think the interesting thing is what's going on there's a modern flavor to it which changes it the modern flavor is that the individual is getting more powerful because they're becoming more leverage.
butcher.zh: 这其中有一种宗教色彩。而资本主义个人主义者则主张自由意志，每个人为自己负责，各取所需，只要每个人都做自己想做的事，最终会实现更大的利益。这就是Adam Smith所说的，市场的“看不见的手”会供养你，面包师应该烤面包，屠夫应该卖肉，烛台制作者应该做烛台，一切都会顺其自然，每个人尽其所能进行交易。那么到底是哪一种理论正确呢？我认为这两者之间永远会有博弈。有趣的是，现代社会出现了一种新的风味，改变了这种博弈。这种现代风味在于，个人因为拥有了更多的杠杆，变得越来越强大。

butcher.en: And there's a religious aspect to it. And then the capitalist individualist is like, libertarian every man for himself you just each do what you want and it'll work out for the greater good that's adam smith you know the invisible hand of the market will feed you the baker should bake and the butcher should butcher and the candlestick maker should make candlesticks and it'll all work out each person does their best and they trade and so which is it which which which which theory is correct and i think there's always going to be a battle between the two and i think the interesting thing is what's going on there's a modern flavor to it which changes it the modern flavor is that the individual is getting more powerful because they're becoming more leverage.
butcher.zh: 这其中有一种宗教色彩。而资本主义个人主义者则主张自由意志，每个人为自己负责，各取所需，只要每个人都做自己想做的事，最终会实现更大的利益。这就是Adam Smith所说的，市场的“看不见的手”会供养你，面包师应该烤面包，屠夫应该卖肉，烛台制作者应该做烛台，一切都会顺其自然，每个人尽其所能进行交易。那么到底是哪一种理论正确呢？我认为这两者之间永远会有博弈。有趣的是，现代社会出现了一种新的风味，改变了这种博弈。这种现代风味在于，个人因为拥有了更多的杠杆，变得越来越强大。

butcher.en: Yeah. so in life you have to choose your regrets i love that as a decision making frame because it also jumpstarts our fear engine because rather than saying like what do i want it's what i what do i hate least You and so we get to run it so then you get to use your run away from engine rather than you go towards to it yeah the mouse and the cheese again yeah and was it you was telling me that yeah with the cat i mean yep so i'm just gonna butcher what you told me um but why don't you share that like how much yeah yeah this was on our last episode so this is sequel for the people that were listening um jordan peterson talks about the study where they starve a rat and they put it into a tube they waft the smell of cheese in from the front and there's a spring attached to the rat's tail so they can work out how hard it's pulling how hard it's pulling is a proxy for desire for how much it wants it you'd think this rat is starving it's going to pull as hard as it can so it waft the smell of cheese in and it runs towards it and whatever they do another iteration of the study this time they waft the smell of cheese in from the front and the smell of a cat in from behind yeah it pulls harder yeah why because not only in life do you want to run towards something you want but you want to run away from something that you fear.
butcher.zh: 没错。所以人生中你必须做出选择，我喜欢把这当作一种决策框架，因为它也能启动我们的恐惧引擎，因为与其问自己“我想要什么”，不如问“我最不想要什么”。这样我们就能利用“逃离”的引擎，而不是“奔向”的引擎。又是老鼠和奶酪的例子，对吧？是你跟我讲的这个关于猫的故事吗？我可能会把你讲的内容复述得乱七八糟，但你为什么不分享一下呢？这是我们上一期的内容，所以这对听众来说算是续集。Jordan Peterson 谈到过一个研究，他们让老鼠挨饿，然后把它放进管子里，从前面飘来奶酪的香味，老鼠尾巴上连着弹簧，这样他们就能算出它拉力有多大，拉力大小代表了欲望的强弱。你可能会觉得这只老鼠饿坏了，它会拼命往前拉。于是他们飘来奶酪的香味，它就向着奶酪跑去。不管他们怎么做，在研究的另一轮迭代中，这次他们从前面飘来奶酪的香味，从后面飘来猫的气味。结果它拉得更用力了。为什么？因为在生活中，你不仅想奔向你想要的东西，还想逃离你恐惧的东西。

burden.en: Studies, multiple studies have shown, and I think a meta-analysis as well, has shown that people who have a strong group of friends actually have better romantic relationships because the burden of your relationship is now lessened by having this community as opposed to people who merge with one person and then all their hopes, aspirations, dreams, fears, frustrations are just poured on them.
burden.zh: 研究，多项研究表明，我想还有一个荟萃分析也表明，拥有强大朋友圈的人实际上有更好的浪漫关系，因为你的关系的负担现在被这个社区减轻了，而不是像那些只与一个人融合，然后把所有的希望、抱负、梦想、恐惧、挫折都倾注在对方身上的人。
